ki.$description: Compact density (spec 045): Material's -2 step, controls and rows 8px shorter, container spacing x 0.75. Declared with data-ki-density="compact" on any element; data-ki-density="default" restores the default inside it.

control-offset.$description: Controls and rows 8px shorter (40 -> 32 in onmars, 48 -> 40 for material3 fields).
